articles.summary: BOSTON , April 24, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Boston Beer Company, Inc. (NYSE: SAM), today reported financial results for the first quarter ended March 29, 2025 . Key results were: First Quarter 2025 Summary: Depletions decreased 1% and shipments increased 5.3% Net revenue of $453.9 million
articles.title: Boston Beer Reports First Quarter Financial Results
